[[Finding Jinnai (Hard mode)]] | followed by = [[Raid on Kaineng Center (Hard mode)]] | solo = y | map = }} Sneak into the mercenaries' meeting for a little bit of recon. ==Quest information== ===Objectives=== * Travel to [[Shadow's Passage]] and investigate the meeting. * Speak with the attendees to find out what the criminals are planning. Avoid the group you are disguised as and mind your tongue. The wrong words will draw unwanted attention. * Go listen to the criminal's speech. Leaving early will blow your cover. * Escape the meeting. * See Guardsman Qao Lin for your reward. ===Reward=== *5,000 [[Experience]] *2,000 [[Gold]] *[[Imperial Guard Requisition Order]] *Imperial Guard Requisition Order *[[Imperial Commendation]] ==See also== * Quest walkthrough, NPCs, dialogue, and notes can be found on [[Calling All Thugs]].
